Mention of other vitamin D derivatives that have been studied in psoriasis can be found under Vitamin D Substances, p.1986. Described in this chapter are Calcipotriol, p.1591 Tacalcitol, p.1615 Wound Management Agents Many compounds and dressings are used in the manage- ment of wounds and ulcers. Although some are included in this chapter, others can be found throughout Martindale, including white and yellow soft paraffins (p.2031), algi- nates such as calcium alginate (p.1058), proteolytic en- zymes such as collagenase (p.2286) and fibrinolysin (p.1287), and fibrin glue (p.1069). Described in this chapter are Becaplermin, p.1590 Polyphloroglucinol Centella, p.1592 Phosphate, p.1611 Cerous Nitrate, p.1593 Polyurethane Foam, p.1611 Crilanomer, p.1593 Prezatide Copper Acetate, Dextranomer, p.1593 p.1611 Maggots, p.1604 Skin Substitutes, p.1613 Topical Drug Administration For drugs that are applied topically, the vehicle and for- mulation may be as important as the active drug. In- deed, some cream and ointment bases are used alone for their protective or emollient properties, while ad- verse effects of topical preparations are sometimes at- tributed to constituents of the vehicle such as stabilisers and preservatives.
